title: Generated DIMASSOC body recovery profile
scope: Malformed DIMASSOC OBJECTS-body recovery and CLI disposition at revisions where the generated body contains a parser-failing one-bit mutation.

selection.source: P6-F typed OBJECTS parser and writer inventory
selection.reason: DIMASSOC has a typed AC1021+ parser and writer. A zero-associativity profile isolates recovery without claiming a dimension target or associative relationship.

source.provenance: Generated from scratch by the in-tree dwg_local_roundtrip test writer and removed by the test runner.
source.profile: One DIMASSOC with no OsnapPointRef entries, a null dimension pointer, and a following LINE sentinel.
source.mutation: The generator searches the bounded body for a one-bit mutation rejected by DRW_DimensionAssociation::parseDwg while preserving the common OBJECTS prologue and handle.

AC1024.status: excluded; no one-bit parser-failing mutation was found in the bounded generated body

AC1027.output: strict and partial output refused by the existing source-reference gate

assertions: At AC1021, AC1027, and AC1032, the generated source continues through the following LINE and reports one failed OBJECTS frame, zero entity parse failures, and balanced source/published/failed frame accounting.
At AC1021 and AC1032, strict ASCII/Binary conversion refuses atomically and explicit-partial ASCII/Binary output passes fresh DXF readback with the LINE retained.
At AC1027, strict and explicit-partial output preserve the destination and refuse at the existing source-reference gate.

validation.syntax: python3 -m py_compile tests/dwg2dxf_cli_contract_tests.py passed before the final receipt and plan edits.
validation.diff_check: git diff --check passed before the final receipt and plan edits.
validation.targeted: ctest --test-dir build-gcc -V -R '^dwg2dxf_cli_dimassoc_recovery$' passed 1/1 in 0.45 seconds and reported 13 controls.
validation.aggregate: The longer dwg2dxf_cli_partial_read_disposition aggregate was not rerun for this isolated selector slice.

limits: Generated parser recovery and CLI disposition only; no DIMASSOC-to-DIMENSION relationship, OsnapPointRef semantics, dependency closure, producer prevalence, or native associativity is qualified.
AC1024 is excluded because its bounded source body yielded no parser-failing one-bit mutation.
AC1027 output remains refused by the existing source-reference gate.
No DWG or DXF fixture file is committed.
